pages.title: Where to find
pages.text: Look for the encounter at: Underworld Arena.

pages.title: How to fight
pages.text: Helvar rejects normal hits during cinematics. While protected, ordinary hits are blocked; hitting him while stuck removes one immunity stack and deals reduced damage. Bait the stuck state, strip the stacks and use the ensuing knockdown as an attack window.

pages.title: What does not work
pages.text: It marks the site on your map; the locator itself does not begin combat. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory. Reading the handbook does not grant an Eye or record a victory.

pages.title: Drops
pages.text: Native loot for this encounter includes: Helvar's Sword. Inspect the obtained item’s uses in JEI to choose your next equipment. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory. In an active campaign this main-boss victory is linked to the Undead Eye. Reading the handbook does not grant an Eye or record a victory.
